verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂ֨א אֹתִ֜י ר֗וּחַ וַתָּבֵ֣א אֹ֠תִי אֶל־ שַׁ֨עַר בֵּית־ יְהוָ֤ה הַקַּדְמוֹנִי֙ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ימָה וְהִנֵּה֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח הַשַּׁ֔עַר עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ וָאֶרְאֶ֨ה בְתוֹכָ֜ם אֶת־ יַאֲזַנְיָ֧ה בֶן־ עַזֻּ֛ר וְאֶת־ פְּלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ בְּנָיָ֖הוּ שָׂרֵ֖י הָעָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wat·tiś·śā ’ō·ṯî rū·aḥ wat·tā·ḇê ’ō·ṯî ’el- ša·‘ar bêṯ- Yah·weh haq·qaḏ·mō·w·nî hap·pō·w·neh qā·ḏî·māh wə·hin·nêh bə·p̄e·ṯaḥ haš·ša·‘ar ‘eś·rîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh ’îš wā·’er·’eh ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵām ’eṯ- ya·’ă·zan·yāh ḇen- ‘az·zur wə·’eṯ- pə·laṭ·yā·hū ḇen- bə·nā·yā·hū śā·rê hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Then the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the LORD that faces east And there at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five . . . men Among them I saw Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah who were leaders of the people
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO me levantou o Espírito, e me levou à porta oriental da casa do SENHOR, a qual olha para o oriente; e eis que estavam à entrada da porta vinte e cinco homens; e no meio deles vi a Jaazanias, filho de Azur, e a Pelatias, filho de Benaia, príncipes do povo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם אֵ֣לֶּה הָאֲנָשִׁ֞ים הַחֹשְׁבִ֥ים אָ֛וֶן וְהַיֹּעֲצִ֥ים עֲצַת־ רָ֖ע בָּעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy ben- ’ā·ḏām ’êl·leh hā·’ă·nā·šîm ha·ḥō·šə·ḇîm ’ā·wen wə·hay·yō·‘ă·ṣîm ‘ă·ṣaṯ- rā‘ bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me Son of man these are the men who plot evil and give wicked counsel in this city
verses.literalPt: E disse-me: Filho do homem, estes são os homens que maquinam perversidade, e dão mau conselho nesta cidade.

verses.original: הָאֹ֣מְרִ֔ים לֹ֥א בְקָר֖וֹב בְּנ֣וֹת בָּתִּ֑ים הִ֣יא הַסִּ֔יר וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ הַבָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: hā·’ō·mə·rîm lō ḇə·qā·rō·wḇ bə·nō·wṯ bāt·tîm hî has·sîr wa·’ă·naḥ·nū hab·bā·śār
verses.literal: They are saying Is not the time near to build houses The city is the cooking pot and we are the meat
verses.literalPt: Os quais dizem: Não está próximo o tempo de edificar casas; esta cidade é o caldeirão, e nós a carne.

verses.original: לָכֵ֖ן הִנָּבֵ֣א עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הִנָּבֵ֖א בֶּן־ אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nā·ḇê ‘ă·lê·hem hin·nā·ḇê ben- ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: Therefore prophesy against them prophesy O son of man
verses.literalPt: Portanto, profetiza contra eles; profetiza, ó filho do homem.

verses.original: וַתִּפֹּ֣ל עָלַי֮ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י אֱמֹר֙ כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה כֵּ֥ן אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַעֲל֥וֹת רֽוּחֲכֶ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְדַעְתִּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tip·pōl ‘ā·lay rū·aḥ Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ’ĕ·mōr kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh kên ’ă·mar·tem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ rū·ḥă·ḵem ’ă·nî yə·ḏa‘·tî·hā
verses.literal: And the Spirit of the LORD fell upon me and told me to declare that this is what the LORD says That is what you are thinking O house of Israel and I know the thoughts that arise in your minds
verses.literalPt: Caiu, pois, sobre mim o Espírito do SENHOR, e disse-me: Fala: Assim diz o SENHOR: Assim haveis falado, ó casa de Israel, porque, quanto às coisas que vos sobem ao espírito, eu as conheço.

verses.original: הִרְבֵּיתֶ֥ם חַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וּמִלֵּאתֶ֥ם חוּצֹתֶ֖יהָ חָלָֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: hir·bê·ṯem ḥal·lê·ḵem bā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ū·mil·lê·ṯem ḥū·ṣō·ṯe·hā ḥā·lāl
verses.literal: You have multiplied those you killed in this city and filled its streets with the dead
verses.literalPt: Multiplicastes os vossos mortos nesta cidade, e enchestes as suas ruas de mortos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ חַלְלֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שַׂמְתֶּ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ הֵ֥מָּה הַבָּשָׂ֖ר וְהִ֣יא הַסִּ֑יר וְאֶתְכֶ֖ם הוֹצִ֥יא מִתּוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ḥal·lê·ḵem ’ă·šer śam·tem bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh hêm·māh hab·bā·śār wə·hî has·sîr wə·’eṯ·ḵem hō·w·ṣî mit·tō·w·ḵāh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says The slain you have laid within this city are the meat and the city is the pot but I will remove you from it
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Vossos mortos, que deitastes no meio dela, esses são a carne e ela é o caldeirão; a vós, porém, vos tirarei do meio dela.

verses.original: חֶ֖רֶב יְרֵאתֶ֑ם וְחֶ֙רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ yə·rê·ṯem wə·ḥe·reḇ ’ā·ḇî ‘ă·lê·ḵem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: You fear the sword so I will bring the sword against you declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Temestes a espada, e a espada trarei sobre vós, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִתּוֹכָ֔הּ וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־ זָרִ֑ים וְעָשִׂ֛יתִי בָכֶ֖ם שְׁפָטִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem mit·tō·w·ḵāh wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·yaḏ- zā·rîm wə·‘ā·śî·ṯî ḇā·ḵem šə·p̄ā·ṭîm
verses.literal: I will bring you out of the city and deliver you into the hands of foreigners and I will execute judgments against you
verses.literalPt: E vos farei sair do meio dela, e vos entregarei na mão de estrangeiros, e exercerei os meus juízos entre vós.

verses.original: בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפֹּ֔לוּ עַל־ גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפּ֣וֹט אֶתְכֶ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥe·reḇ tip·pō·lū ‘al- gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl ’eš·pō·wṭ ’eṯ·ḵem wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: You will fall by the sword and I will judge you even to the borders of Israel Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Caireis à espada, e nos confins de Israel vos julgarei; e sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: הִ֗יא לֹֽא־ תִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְסִ֔יר וְאַתֶּ֛ם תִּהְי֥וּ בְתוֹכָ֖הּ לְבָשָׂ֑ר אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hî lō- ṯih·yeh lā·ḵem lə·sîr wə·’at·tem tih·yū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh lə·ḇā·śār ’el- gə·ḇūl yiś·rā·’êl ’eš·pōṭ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: The city will not be a pot for you nor will you be the meat within it I will judge you even to the borders of Israel
verses.literalPt: Esta cidade não vos servirá de caldeirão, nem vós servireis de carne no meio dela; nos confins de Israel vos julgarei.

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּחֻקַּי֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽכְמִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ă·šer bə·ḥuq·qay lō hă·laḵ·tem ū·miš·pā·ṭay lō ‘ă·śî·ṯem ū·ḵə·miš·pə·ṭê hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ‘ă·śî·ṯem
verses.literal: Then you will know that I am the LORD For you have neither followed My statutes nor practiced My ordinances but you have conformed to the ordinances of the nations around you
verses.literalPt: E sabereis que eu sou o SENHOR, porque não andastes nos meus estatutos, nem cumpristes os meus juízos; antes fizestes conforme os juízos dos gentios que estão ao redor de vós.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כְּהִנָּ֣בְאִ֔י וּפְלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ בְּנָיָ֖ה מֵ֑ת וָאֶפֹּ֨ל עַל־ פָּנַ֜י וָאֶזְעַ֣ק קוֹל־ גָּד֗וֹל וָאֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה כָּלָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·hin·nā·ḇə·’î ū·p̄ə·laṭ·yā·hū ḇen- bə·nā·yāh mêṯ wā·’ep·pōl ‘al- pā·nay wā·’ez·‘aq qō·wl- gā·ḏō·wl wā·’ō·mar ’ă·hāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kā·lāh ’at·tāh ‘ō·śeh ’êṯ šə·’ê·rîṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now as I was prophesying Pelatiah son of Benaiah died Then I fell facedown . . . and cried out in a loud . . . voice Oh Lord GOD will You bring . . . the remnant of Israel to a complete end
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, profetizando eu, morreu Pelatias, filho de Benaia; então caí sobre o meu rosto, e clamei com grande voz, e disse: Ah! Senhor DEUS! Porventura darás tu fim ao remanescente de Israel?

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם אַחֶ֤יךָ אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י גְאֻלָּתֶ֔ךָ וְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ אָמְר֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם רַֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ הִ֛יא נִתְּנָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמוֹרָשָֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ’a·ḥe·ḵā ’a·ḥe·ḵā ’an·šê ḡə·’ul·lā·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḵāl bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kul·lōh ’ă·šer ’ā·mə·rū lā·hem yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ra·ḥă·qū mê·‘al Yah·weh lā·nū hî nit·tə·nāh hā·’ā·reṣ lə·mō·w·rā·šāh
verses.literal: Son of man your brothers your relatives your fellow exiles . . . and the whole house of Israel are those of whom the people of Jerusalem have said They are far away from the LORD this land has been given to us as a possession
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, teus irmãos, sim, teus irmãos, os homens de teu parentesco, e toda a casa de Israel, todos eles são aqueles a quem os habitantes de Jerusalém disseram: Apartai-vos para longe do SENHOR; esta terra nos foi dada em possessão.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ כִּ֤י הִרְחַקְתִּים֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְכִ֥י הֲפִֽיצוֹתִ֖ים בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וָאֱהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ לְמִקְדָּ֣שׁ מְעַ֔ט בָּאֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kî hir·ḥaq·tîm bag·gō·w·yim wə·ḵî hă·p̄î·ṣō·w·ṯîm bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ wā·’ĕ·hî lā·hem lə·miq·dāš mə·‘aṭ bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer- bā·’ū šām
verses.literal: Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says Although I sent them far away among the nations . . . and scattered them among the countries yet for a little while I have been a sanctuary for them in the countries to which they have gone . . .
verses.literalPt: Portanto, dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ainda que os lancei para longe entre os gentios, e ainda que os espalhei pelas terras, todavia lhes serei como um pequeno santuário, nas terras para onde forem.

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ וְקִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִן־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצוֹתֶ֖ם בָּהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·qib·baṣ·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·‘am·mîm wə·’ā·sap̄·tî ’eṯ·ḵem min- hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer nə·p̄ō·ṣō·w·ṯem bā·hem wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem ’eṯ- ’aḏ·maṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore declare that this is what the Lord GOD says I will gather you from the peoples and assemble you from the countries to which you have been scattered and I will give back to you the land of Israel
verses.literalPt: Portanto, dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Hei de ajuntar-vos do meio dos povos, e vos recolherei das terras para onde fostes lançados, e vos darei a terra de Israel.

verses.original: וּבָ֖אוּ־ שָׁ֑מָּה וְהֵסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ שִׁקּוּצֶ֛יהָ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū- šām·māh wə·hê·sî·rū ’eṯ- kāl- šiq·qū·ṣe·hā wə·’eṯ- kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: When they return to it they will remove - all its detestable things and all its abominations
verses.literalPt: E virão ali, e tirarão dela todas as suas coisas detestáveis e todas as suas abominações.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֔ד וְר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem lêḇ ’e·ḥāḏ wə·rū·aḥ ḥă·ḏā·šāh ’et·tên bə·qir·bə·ḵem wa·hă·si·rō·ṯî lêḇ hā·’e·ḇen mib·bə·śā·rām wə·nā·ṯat·tî lā·hem lêḇ bā·śār
verses.literal: And I will give them singleness of heart and put a new spirit within them I will remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of flesh
verses.literalPt: E lhes darei um só coração, e um espírito novo porei dentro deles; e tirarei da sua carne o coração de pedra, e lhes darei um coração de carne;

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י יִשְׁמְר֖וּ וְעָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם וְהָיוּ־ לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an bə·ḥuq·qō·ṯay yê·lê·ḵū wə·’eṯ- miš·pā·ṭay yiš·mə·rū wə·‘ā·śū ’ō·ṯām wə·hā·yū- lî lə·‘ām wa·’ă·nî ’eh·yeh lā·hem lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: so that they may follow My statutes keep My ordinances and practice them Then they will be My people and I will be their God
verses.literalPt: Para que andem nos meus estatutos, e guardem os meus juízos, e os cumpram; e eles me serão por povo, e eu lhes serei por Deus.

verses.original: וְאֶל־ לֵ֧ב שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֛ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לִבָּ֣ם הֹלֵ֑ךְ דַּרְכָּם֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֣ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- lêḇ šiq·qū·ṣê·hem wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem lib·bām hō·lêḵ dar·kām bə·rō·šām nā·ṯat·tî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: But as for those whose hearts pursue detestable things and abominations . . . I will bring their conduct down upon their own heads declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Mas, quanto àqueles cujo coração andar conforme o coração das suas coisas detestáveis, e as suas abominações, farei recair nas suas cabeças o seu caminho, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ הַכְּרוּבִים֙ אֶת־ כַּנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָאֽוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְעֻמָּתָ֑ם וּכְב֧וֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·’ū hak·kə·rū·ḇîm ’eṯ- kan·p̄ê·hem wə·hā·’ō·w·p̄an·nîm lə·‘um·mā·ṯām ū·ḵə·ḇō·wḏ ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘ă·lê·hem mil·mā·‘ə·lāh
verses.literal: Then the cherubim with the wheels beside them spread their wings and the glory of the God of Israel was above them
verses.literalPt: Então os querubins elevaram as suas asas, e as rodas os acompanhavam; e a glória do Deus de Israel estava em cima sobre eles.

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַל֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל תּ֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל־ הָהָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִקֶּ֥דֶם לָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh mê·‘al tō·wḵ hā·‘îr way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- hā·hār ’ă·šer miq·qe·ḏem lā·‘îr
verses.literal: And the glory of the LORD rose up from within the city and stood over the mountain east of the city
verses.literalPt: E a glória do SENHOR se alçou desde o meio da cidade; e se pôs sobre o monte que está ao oriente da cidade.

verses.original: וְר֣וּחַ נְשָׂאַ֗תְנִי וַתְּבִיאֵ֤נִי כַשְׂדִּ֙ימָה֙ אֶל־ הַגּוֹלָ֔ה בַּמַּרְאֶ֖ה בְּר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֙עַל֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rū·aḥ nə·śā·’aṯ·nî wat·tə·ḇî·’ê·nî ḵaś·dî·māh ’el- hag·gō·w·lāh bam·mar·’eh bə·rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·ya·‘al mê·‘ā·lay ham·mar·’eh ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯî
verses.literal: And the Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to Chaldea to the exiles in the vision given by the Spirit of God After the vision - had gone up from me
verses.literalPt: Depois o Espírito me levantou, e me levou à Caldéia, para os do cativeiro, em visão, pelo Espírito de Deus; e subiu de sobre mim a visão que eu tinha tido.

verses.original: וָאֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־ הַגּוֹלָ֑ה אֵ֛ת כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶרְאָֽנִי׃פ
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḏab·bêr ’el- hag·gō·w·lāh ’êṯ kāl- diḇ·rê Yah·weh ’ă·šer her·’ā·nî
verses.literal: I told . . . the exiles everything . . . the LORD had shown me
verses.literalPt: E falei aos do cativeiro todas as coisas que o SENHOR me havia mostrado.
